tasks.short: Serve on institutional and departmental committees

steps.what: Read committee papers and consider institutional policies and academic implications
Serve on committees by debating departmental matters, agreeing actions and voting where authorised

tasks.design: Retain paper study and deliberation with the committee member. Existing papers stay in {DOCS}; no secretary workload is assigned to the teacher.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools do not establish shorter personal deliberation.
tasks.still_hard: Policy consequences and competing academic priorities require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher contributes disciplinary experience and tests implications.
tasks.altitude: No change in committee workload or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Member preparation and deliberation remain personal work without an inferred secretary stage.

assumptions: Boundary is ordinary committee membership, excluding minute taking and later policy implementation.
The secretariat supplies existing committee papers upstream with unchanged effort. No machine step needs structured inputs.
No deployment or extra upkeep is proposed; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Does the teacher hold separate secretary duties?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 with zero upkeep; member effort remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide biology experiences outside the classroom

steps.what: Plan course-related field trips around learning goals, site conditions and student needs
Provide students field experiences, supervise activities and explain biological observations

tasks.design: Keep field planning and delivery with the teacher. Existing site information in {DOCS} supports preparation; no booking or consent-form workload is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: The experience depends on the actual site and students.
tasks.enabler_now: Workflow tools do not deliver field teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, access and unexpected observations require adaptation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects real observations to biological concepts.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in planning judgement or field supervision.

evidence.claim: Field planning and supervised delivery remain personal work; no repetitive booking baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is educational planning and field delivery, excluding separate transport procurement and institutional approvals.
Site staff supply existing information upstream with unchanged effort. Student needs are clarified during retained s1; no machine step needs structured records.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which site constraints require a different learning plan?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100, zero upkeep. No reduction in planning judgement or field presence is proposed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the research question, methods, evidence and resources for the grant proposal
Write proposal sections from the defined research plan and verified supporting evidence

loop.input: Author's research brief, verified references and call requirements
loop.output: Proposal draft with claims linked to supplied evidence
loop.check: Teacher checks biological meaning, methods, feasibility, references and every resource commitment
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or changed research aims are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Connecting supplied scientific material into readable prose requires interpretation

steps.what: Check scientific claims and coordinate the final grant proposal for institutional submission

tasks.design: Test call templates in {DOCS} first, then draft bounded prose from the teacher's verified research brief if needed. The teacher checks the final contribution; the institution retains budget approval and external submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing repeats the structure of a defined research plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can reuse supplied evidence under a fixed call structure.
tasks.still_hard: Novelty, methods and feasible commitments remain scientific and institutional judgements.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher defines the research and stands behind its claims.
tasks.altitude: Less initial prose drafting; no added budget or submission authority.

evidence.claim: Drafting from an author's verified research brief is plausible; the digest has no grant-writing time study or validated biological proposal capability.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's scientific proposal through internal handoff. Institutional budget approval, external submission and funder evaluation remain outside and unchanged.

Teacher produces aims, methods, cited evidence, reference identifiers, requested resources, work packages and call section limits in s1's retained 45 hours. Unverified references or absent estimates go to manual writing in s2; no model invents them.
Try native call templates first. Process only authorised research content; no confidential reviewer material is used.
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce writing time after counting all scientific corrections and reference checks?

incremental.description: Maintain call instructions and inspect recurring draft errors
Research support officer checks added draft provenance requirements

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal contribution, references, resource commitments and call version; edits void internal handoff approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=45+18+25=88; gross 12 less 4 focal upkeep gives net 8. Two other-role upkeep hours are excluded. Low is templates already adequate with no add-on; high requires 40% less drafting without shorter scientific development or final review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review biological papers for journal publication

steps.what: Review papers for biological validity, methods, evidence, originality and reporting limitations
Write and submit the journal review with evidence-based comments and a publication recommendation

tasks.design: Keep manuscript evaluation and review authorship with the teacher using the journal's permitted document process in {DOCS}. No manuscript upload to a generative service or generated evaluation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review requires independent scientific judgement on confidential work.
tasks.enabler_now: General drafting tools do not establish a reliable reduction in review effort.
tasks.still_hard: A persuasive manuscript may conceal methodological weaknesses.
tasks.human_edge: The reviewer tests reasoning and takes responsibility for the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: No change in reviewing effort or editorial authority.

evidence.claim: Scientific evaluation and confidential review authorship remain human work; no specific journal policy or automation saving is asserted.

assumptions: Boundary is peer review through submission, excluding editorial decisions and author revisions.
The editor supplies the existing manuscript and review criteria upstream with unchanged effort; no machine input contract is required. Confirm the actual journal's rules.
No new tool or maintenance is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which methodological checks require the most direct reviewer attention?

approvals.approved_version: Exact review text, recommendation, manuscript version and journal recipient; changes require reapproval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. Scientific evaluation and review authorship remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce first-draft grant prose where useful while retaining committee deliberation, field teaching and independent peer review.
reach: Help instructional coordinators map application requirements
Work with librarians on scholarly source verification
role.ambitious_version: A biology teacher with more attention for research design and student field experience after reducing limited proposal drafting effort.
